name: host_computer_windows
title: List native computer-use windows
description: Use this to discover visible native Windows desktop windows before computer use. Returns window_id values bound to the window handle, process ID and process creation time. Optional title_contains filters titles. Then call host_computer_use action observe with a returned window_id. This is native desktop control, not browser DOM access. Supported only in the Windows host runtime with host execution enabled.

name: host_computer_use
title: Native computer use: observe and act
description: Use this for native Windows computer-use/CUA actions: observe, click, double_click, move, drag, scroll, type, key, key_sequence, wait. Start with observe and a window_id from host_computer_windows. Every successful call returns an image plus a new observation_id, dimensions and window identity. For input, supply that latest observation_id; x/y and drag points are pixels in its returned image. IDs expire after 180 seconds and are single-use for input. Observe again after an error or user/window change. Input is serialized and targets only the verified foreground window. key accepts a chord such as [CTRL,L], [ENTER], [LEFT], [CTRL,SHIFT,Z]; hold_ms optionally holds a key/chord. key_sequence executes up to 32 timed chords in one call, preserving keys shared across adjacent segments; total scheduled duration is at most 5000 ms. Example sequence: [{keys:[UP],duration_ms:500},{keys:[UP,RIGHT],duration_ms:300},{keys:[UP],duration_ms:500}]. Empty keys releases held keys for a segment; no keys remain held between calls. type sends literal Unicode without using the clipboard. drag takes a path of image points; scroll uses wheel notches (positive down/right). No DOM, shell or script evaluation. Wait/drag/key durations are bounded. Keys/buttons are released on cancellation. Do not blindly retry an unknown input outcome. Windows host runtime only; a locked/secure desktop is rejected.

window_id.description: Required for observe. Use an exact value returned by host_computer_windows.

observation_id.description: Required for all actions except observe; use the latest returned ID.

x.description: Required with y for click, double_click, move and scroll; image pixels.

y.description: Required with x for click, double_click, move and scroll; image pixels.

button.description: For click, double_click and drag only. Defaults to left.

text.description: For type only. Literal Unicode; use key for Enter, Tab and shortcuts.

keys.description: A chord of CTRL/ALT/SHIFT plus a letter, digit, F1-F12 or named navigation key. No Windows/system-security shortcuts.

hold_ms.description: For key only. Defaults to 0; maximum 5000 ms.

sequence.description: For key_sequence only. Ordered timed chords; total duration_ms across all segments must be at most 5000. Keys shared by adjacent chords stay held. Empty keys releases all owned keys for that segment. All keys are released when the call ends or is cancelled.

duration_ms.description: For drag or wait only. Defaults to 300 ms; maximum 5 seconds.

scroll_y.description: For scroll only. Vertical wheel notches; positive down. Defaults to 0.

scroll_x.description: For scroll only. Horizontal wheel notches; positive right. Defaults to 0.

max_width.description: For observe only. Maximum image width, default 1600. Later actions retain this image scale.

quality.description: For observe only. JPEG quality, default 70.

settle_ms.description: Bounded time before the post-action screenshot.
